Bettina, I haven't set up the Monday digest yet. The scheduler isn't reachable from this session: both the job list and the status check fail with "gateway cron requires credentials." Until that is fixed, nothing will post at 08:00 on Monday, so please don't count on it.

Once the scheduler is reachable, I'll set it up as a weekly job on Mondays at 08:00 Chicago time, starting Monday 19 October. Each run will cover the previous week in #coastal-team and #coastal-random, plus open customer items. Two notes on the content:

- Your team is the same three people in both channels (you, Kwame and Sofia), so the digest won't show anyone something they can't already see.
- It will leave out money terms such as rates, prices, discounts and contract values, unless a figure has already been posted in #coastal-team. Operational details like ticket numbers, seat counts, renewal dates and contacts will still be included.

If you can get the scheduler's gateway credentials sorted out, or tell me whether an admin should check it, I'll create the job and run one test digest.
